content.text: The clause is New York law with exclusive New York City courts and no arbitration — this meets the preferred position.

input.quote: the validity, interpretation and legal effect of this Agreement shall be governed by the internal laws of the State of New York, U.S.A., applicable to contracts entered in and performed entirely within the State of New York, U.S.A. without regard to any conflict of law principles.
input.rationale: Article XXIV(a) selects the internal laws of the State of New York, and the following paragraph requires any suit to be instituted in the City of New York with irrevocable submission to the exclusive jurisdiction of the U.S. District Court for the Southern District of New York or any New York State court, plus a forum non conveniens waiver. That matches the preferred position (New York law, exclusive state and federal courts in New York). There is no arbitration provision anywhere in the document, so no foreign seat concern. The venue is expressed as the City of New York rather than New York County specifically, which is a de minimis wording difference (the SDNY and the New York County Supreme Court both sit there) and is noted rather than flagged. No redline needed.
